bias.en: Turning bearish · MACD crossed down, lost $248.6
bias.zh: 转空 · MACD 下穿，失守 $248.6

read.en: Amazon fell 1.0% on Oct 23 to $248.00, trading between $246.45 and $250.01. It is below the rising 5-day ($257.2), 10-day ($256.3) and 30-day ($253.4) averages and the falling 100-day ($251.8), and above the rising 200-day ($243.3). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 23 but is still above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 22 ($264.99), and RSI is 43.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月23日下跌 1.0%，收于 $248.00，盘中区间 $246.45–250.01。股价位于上行的 5 日（$257.2）、10 日（$256.3）和 30 日均线（$253.4）以及下行的 100 日均线（$251.8）下方，高于上行的 200 日均线（$243.3）。MACD 于 10月23日下穿信号线，但仍在零轴上方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看空（$264.99），RSI 为 43。

read.en: The MACD cross confirms Wednesday's turn, and the close slipped under the $248.6 Oct 15–16 lows, now resistance. Resistance is $248.6–250, then $251.8–253.4 (100 and 30-day) and $256–258.4 (5 and 10-day, Oct 22 high). Support is $246.5 (Oct 23 low), then $243.3–244.7 (200-day, September lows). A close above $253.4 would target $258; a close below $243.3 would open the $226 July lows.
read.zh: MACD 下穿确认了周三的转弱，收盘跌破 $248.6（10月15–16日低点），该位置转为阻力。阻力为 $248.6–250，其次 $251.8–253.4（100 日和 30 日均线）和 $256–258.4（5 日和 10 日均线、10月22日高点）。支撑为 $246.5（10月23日低点），其次 $243.3–244.7（200 日均线、9 月低点）。若收盘站上 $253.4，下一目标看 $258；若收盘跌破 $243.3，将打开 $226 的 7 月低点。

r.en: Oct 15 and Oct 16 lows $248.6, now resistance; Oct 23 high $250.0
